scripts.audit:citations: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs');let f=0;for(const s of fs.readdirSync('scripts').filter(x=>/^verify-.*-citations.mjs$/.test(x))){try{execSync('node scripts/'+s,{stdio:'pipe'})}catch(e){f++;console.log('FAIL '+s);process.stdout.write(e.stdout||'')}}console.log(f?f+' verifier(s) failing':'all citation verifiers pass');process.exit(f?1:0)"
scripts.audit: npm run audit:citations && npm run audit:corpus && npm run audit:sources && npm run audit:depth
